title: Get a wrong charge taken off a bill
asked: Call my internet provider and get the wrong $30 charge taken off my October bill. Ask for a reference number.
goal: Ask billing to remove a wrong charge of 30 dollars on the October bill and get a reference number.
outcome: The $30 charge was removed from the October bill. Reference number NS-18145.

title: It asks you when it lacks a detail
asked: Call my internet provider and get the wrong $30 charge taken off my October bill.
goal: Ask billing to remove a wrong charge of 30 dollars on the October bill and get a reference number.
outcome: The $30 charge was removed from the October bill and a reference number NS36618 was provided.
note: The agent asked for the service address. The AI did not have it, so it asked the user mid-call, got the answer in a few seconds, and carried on.
